# Elena Laziuk — Frontend Developer

> Freelance frontend developer from Belarus. Turnkey website layout from Figma designs (HTML/CSS/JS, React, Vue, Bitrix24), responsive layout, bug fixing. Landing pages from 450 BYN. Works in Russian and English.

The portfolio page (https://lenacode.by/) is a single page with sections: services and prices, work process, projects, FAQ and contacts. It has a RU/EN language switch.

## Projects

- [PrettyPaw](https://laziukalena.github.io/prettyPaw/): multi-page zoo website with a video background, Swiper sliders and GSAP animations; built with Webpack and SCSS
- [Park Hotel](https://laziukalena.github.io/Park-Hotel/): one-page hotel website with a booking form validated in JavaScript
- [Agate](https://laziukalena.github.io/Agate/): one-page restaurant website in HTML and SCSS, no JavaScript
- [Profremont](https://laziukalena.github.io/middle_diplom/): three-page website for a windows and balconies company; Bootstrap 3, vanilla JavaScript, calculator and lead forms
- [KUGOO](https://laziukalena.github.io/kugoo/): e-scooter landing page with cart, favourites, comparison and test-drive booking
- [Aliance Production](https://test.lenacode.by/): corporate website on PHP templates; leads are sent to a Telegram bot
